verdict.pick: iReliev Wireless TENS + EMS Muscle Stimulator
verdict.line: Picture a busy parent who needs quick, portable pain relief. The iReliev Wireless offers a lightweight design, Bluetooth connectivity, and a 30‑minute battery life that lets you use it on the go. Its only drawback is that it lacks a built‑in display for settings.
